title: Can Jev complete After Hours on the lean question?
question: Is `lean` (facts, not conclusions) ready to be the default: does a lean journey match run B?
hypothesis: With lean assists Jev completes the whole journey with no collisions and at most 1.2 times the decisions it needs with full assists (the NEXT_MODEL tripwire for making lean the default).

motivation.observation: NEXT_MODEL.md's first tripwire: make lean the default when every assist it drops retires on the probes and one full lean journey matches run B. The probes answer the first half cheaply; this experiment is the second half.

conditions.label: Lean (the bet on the next model)

falsificationCriteria: lean fails to complete runs that full completes: keep full as the default
limitations: Expensive: about 200 billable calls per journey. Run the probes first; they are a hundred times cheaper.
